channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Simulador tira dúvida de eleitores sobre a votação; saiba mais
item.description: The TSE Voting Simulator allows voters to practice the voting process using fictional candidates and numbers, helping to prevent errors on election day.

item.title: Margem Equatorial Brasileira: desafios e potencial em soberania, desenvolvimento e transição justa
item.description: The discovery of hydrocarbons in the Amazon mouth sedimentary basin, in the Brazilian Equatorial Margin, reinforces the country's energy potential and Petrobras' expertise in ultra-deep waters. Despite the need for economic and environmental feasibility assessments, the finding contributes to national energy security and strategic sovereignty. Ineep and FUP emphasize the urgency of a long-term energy planning with social participation and state coordination.

item.title: Aneel diz não ter verba para divulgar mercado livre de energia
item.description: The Brazilian electricity regulator Aneel states it lacks budget resources to fund the communication campaign required by the presidential decree opening the free energy market to residential consumers. Director-general Sandoval Feitosa said the agency needs additional funding to hire advertising and communication agencies and has requested support from the Chief of Staff and the Ministry of Planning. Although facing financial constraints, Aneel says it is willing to implement the outreach plan if provided with the necessary resources.

item.title: Flávio joga futebol em SP, marca 2 gols e é carregado após partida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro played soccer with children in São Paulo, scored two goals, and was celebrated by participants. During his agenda in the capital, he visited the Mercadão de São Miguel alongside Mayor Ricardo Nunes and Senate candidates, facing a protest.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Crise no varejo aumenta pressão fiscal e preocupa governo e campanha de Lula
item.description: The retail crisis, worsened by Casas Bahia's judicial recovery, has increased fiscal pressure and concerns the government and Lula's campaign. High interest rates and lack of fiscal adjustment worry businesses, banks, and the president's allies, who see risks to the economy and re-election.

item.title: STF AO VIVO – Atuação do MPU e emendas parlamentares- sessão de 20/8/2026
item.description: The STF rules on ADI 5982 regarding the performance of the MPU in Santa Catarina and joint actions on parliamentary amendments in Mato Grosso, Paraíba, and Rondônia, including cases resumed after suspensions by ministers such as Edson Fachin and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Ambiente digital seguro depende de toda a sociedade, indica debate com 'jovens senadores'
item.description: During a public hearing of the Commission on Education and Culture, participants of the Young Senator Program 2026 discussed the creation of safer digital environments and the fight against misinformation. Senator Paulo Paim emphasized the importance of dialogue between young people and experts to foster a healthy and democratic cyberspace, while TSE representatives stressed the need to adapt communication and regulation amid high political polarization.

item.title: Deputado do PL entra na UFBA para tirar adesivos do PT e gera tumulto
item.description: State Deputy Diego Castro (PL-BA) entered UFBA to remove stickers supporting Lula and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, causing a disturbance with students and professors at the Ondina campus in Salvador. The lawmaker was recorded removing campaign materials and claimed he was assaulted while preventing a supposed PT campaign.

item.title: Presidente da CCJ do Senado doa R$ 100 mil para filho candidato
item.description: The president of the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee, Otto Alencar (PSD-BA), donated R$ 100,000 to his son Daniel Alencar's (PSD-BA) campaign for the Chamber of Deputies. The donation exceeds the senator's declared assets in 2022.

item.title: Mendonça manda derrubar vídeo com IA que liga Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to Banco Master CEO Daniel Vorcaro using deepfake imagery in a musical parody format. The Instagram post, made by an unidentified profile, must be removed within 24 hours under review for possible electoral violations.

item.title: Onde estão os campeões olímpicos 10 anos após medalha de ouro inédita
item.description: Ten years after Brazil's first-ever Olympic gold medal in 2016, the victorious squad members have taken varied paths: several play in Europe or Brazilian clubs, some have retired, and a few earned call-ups for the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Não vejo que há excesso de isenções fiscais em São Paulo hoje, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated there is no excessive tax exemptions in the state, rejecting criticism from his opponent Fernando Haddad (PT). The debate on tax exemptions is a recurring theme in Tarcísio's re-election campaign. He argues that current exemptions are within normal parameters and contribute to the state's economic development.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que não houve queda na qualidade da educação em SP e critica Haddad
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas claimed there was no decline in education quality in the state, countering rival Fernando Haddad's frequent criticisms. He defended his administration's record and challenged Haddad's assertions as baseless.

item.title: Pernambuco: Raquel Lyra exalta parceria com Lula, mas evita declarar voto para presidente
item.description: Raquel Lyra praises partnership with Lula but avoids declaring presidential vote. The governor of Pernambuco, running for re-election with the PSD, keeps her campaign focused on the state race and does not mention Ronaldo Caiado.

item.title: Tarcísio reconhece que letalidade policial em SP é alta
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas, São Paulo's governor and re-election candidate, acknowledged that police lethality in the state is high but emphasized the need for security actions to combat organized crime. He highlighted the importance of police work despite criticism over excessive firearm use.

item.title: SP vai cumprir metas do marco de saneamento até 2030, promete Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas promised the state will meet basic sanitation targets by 2030, noting that Sabesp privatization increased investment capacity.

item.title: UE enviará missão de peritos para acompanhar eleições no Brasil
item.description: The European Union will send a mission of five independent experts to monitor the 2026 Brazilian elections, focusing technically on the electoral process. The team, arriving next week, will submit a report to the TSE and Itamaraty. Unlike traditional observers, the mission emphasizes a more specialized approach.

item.title: Oposição pede abertura de CPMI para investigar Lulinha
item.description: Opposition requests opening of a CPI to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, over alleged influence peddling in cannabis-related business deals. The initiative, led by Carlos Viana and PL lawmakers, seeks to investigate whether the president's son leveraged his influence for private gain. The probe stems from Federal Police findings about meetings and discussions involving lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro.

item.title: Decisão em 16 horas e aviso prévio a ministros: os bastidores da medida do TSE que tirou Marçal de debates e vetou fundo eleitoral
item.description: Unanimously and within just 16 hours, the TSE decided to restrict Pablo Marçal's campaign rights, denying him access to public funds, debates, and free electoral advertising while his eligibility remains under review. The swift decision aimed to prevent the candidate from benefiting from campaign prerogatives before a final ruling on his candidacy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que já prestou contas sobre 'Dark Horse' e tenta colar caso Master a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed he has already accounted for expenses related to the documentary 'Dark Horse' and shifted scrutiny toward President Lula, referencing potential irregularities involving former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master. During a campaign event in São Paulo, the PL candidate also mentioned Lula's meetings with Vorcaro and Augusto Lima.

item.title: TSE se divide, e Kassio decidirá se Crivella pode concorrer ao Senado
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques will decide if Marcelo Crivella can run for the Senate, following a divided court. The ruling will be issued on Thursday, involving electoral legal aspects.

item.title: Flávio come pastel e promete “arrumar a bagunça” de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) used a stop at the São Paulo Municipal Market to criticize President Lula's (PT) government and promised to 'fix the mess' left by the petista. During his campaign event, the presidential candidate ate a pastel and reinforced his anti-government rhetoric.

item.title: Flávio diz que Dark Horse é "página virada" sem apresentar contas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro called the Dark Horse case 'closed' without releasing the film's financial records, while the Attorney General's Office requests the Lulinha case be moved to first instance. The TSE banned Pablo Marçal from accessing electoral funding and debates, and the MP impeached Arruda's candidacy for the GDF due to ineligibility. Lula reaffirmed the need for impartial investigation by the PF against his son.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra o ponto em que eleitores de Lula e de Flávio concordam
item.description: Ipsos research reveals convergence between Lula and Flávio supporters in favoring a strong government focused on economic development and lowering the cost of living. Marco Antonio Rocha notes that 47% of respondents advocate for greater state intervention to address inequality and international uncertainties. This convergence transcends traditional ideological divides.

item.title: Prefeita do interior de Minas filiada ao PT declara apoio a Cleitinho na disputa pelo governo estadual
item.description: The mayor of Frei Gaspar (MG), Jackeliny Pereira do Nascimento (PT), declared support for Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) for the state government, contrary to the PT's indication of Patrus Ananias. The support generated criticism from the state PT leadership, but the mayor kept the social media post.

item.title: Lula quer apuração de vazamentos “seletivos” no caso Lulinha
item.description: President Lula asked lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho to investigate selective police leaks in the case involving his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. During a meeting at the Alvorada Palace, Lula expressed concern over parallels to Lava Jato, stating he will not use the Federal Police to protect allies. The case also involves allegations of a cannabinoid contract scheme by lobbyist Antonio Carlos Antunes.

item.title: Durigan defende controle de gastos em prol da credibilidade do governo
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan defended public spending controls through the Fiscal Framework to ensure the federal government's economic credibility. He emphasized that fiscal stability and a 2% GDP effort are essential for Lula's reelection. Durigan also criticized opposition proposals, calling them 'meaningless'.

item.title: Rodrigo Manga é expulso do Republicanos por apoiar campanha da esposa no União Brasil
item.description: The mayor of Sorocaba, Rodrigo Manga, was expelled from the Republicanos party for supporting his wife, Sirlange Maganhato's, congressional bid under União Brasil, violating party loyalty rules. The expulsion comes as Manga faces criminal charges linked to alleged municipal management irregularities. The case underscores tensions between partisan alliances and family dynamics in local politics.

item.title: Os jogos da Libertadores que mais atraíram interesse dos torcedores
item.description: Brazilian clubs dominate interest in Libertadores matches, with five of the six most accessed clubs worldwide. Flamengo leads the page access ranking, followed by Palmeiras and Boca Juniors. All ten most-watched matches featured at least one Brazilian team, with particular emphasis on games involving Palmeiras.

item.title: A aposta da chapa de Renan Santos para disputar a Faria Lima com Flávio
item.description: Aroldo Medina, running mate of Renan Santos, emphasized legal security and charisma as key differentiators, indirectly criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro. Medina claimed a clean record and pledged to improve business conditions, while questioning Flávio's reliability.

item.title: TSE proíbe Pablo Marçal de ir a debates e de acessar dinheiro do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: The TSE banned Pablo Marçal from accessing Electoral Fund resources and participating in debates, restricting his presidential campaign. The Electoral Public Ministry questions his eligibility due to lack of proof of party affiliation and prior convictions. The ruling on the registration of his candidacy has not yet been scheduled.

item.title: Tarcísio contraria Flávio Bolsonaro e defende urnas eletrônicas: 'foram elas que me elegeram'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas, Republicanos candidate for SP governor, defended electronic voting machines in a public interview, contradicting Flávio Bolsonaro's criticism, and said the machines elected him. He also criticized Lula's economic policies and warned of potential recessions, reaffirming support for Flávio's presidential bid.

item.title: Aneel aciona TSE sobre operação do setor elétrico para El Niño
item.description: Aneel notified the TSE regarding contingency measures to mitigate the effects of El Niño on the power supply, particularly in isolated areas of the Amazon region ahead of the October elections. Director Sandoval Feitosa announced the advance of funds for independent power plants, with no tariff or fiscal impact, to ensure fuel availability. The main concern is safeguarding election operations amid forecasts of severe drought in the north.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula “persegue” SP por ser governado pela oposição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused President Lula of politically targeting São Paulo due to opposition from Tarcísio and Nunes, pledging to unblock credit operations if elected. He framed the presidential race as a war between Brazil and the PT, reinforcing alliances with figures like Pablo Marçal.

item.title: Zema encontra motoboys em SP, e entregador acusa colegas de receber R$ 200
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) met with motoboys in São Paulo, where a delivery worker accused colleagues of receiving R$200 to attend the meeting. The controversy caused turmoil, and the accuser was removed by the candidate's security.

item.title: TSE barra acesso de Marçal a fundos públicos e participação em debates
item.description: The TSE granted an emergency injunction to prevent Pablo Marçal from accessing public campaign funds and participating in electoral debates until the legal status of his candidacy is resolved.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro elogia Pablo Marçal: ‘Cara do bem, preparado e bem-intencionado’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praised Pablo Marçal, calling him 'a good person' and 'well-prepared,' and advocated for unity among candidates against the PT. During a visit to São Paulo, he emphasized social initiatives and avoided discussing the accounting of the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Douglas Ruas defende que vencedor das eleições de outubro assuma o governo do Rio antecipadamente
item.description: Deputy Douglas Ruas (PL), candidate for Rio de Janeiro state government, supports having the October election winner assume the governorship early instead of a interim term. He opposes holding a special election for an interim government, arguing the regular election result can determine the next governor. The matter is under review by the Supreme Federal Court (STF), as the state remains under interim leadership by Ricardo Couto, a judge at the Rio de Janeiro State Supreme Court.

item.title: Flávio diz que Marçal é um 'cara bem-intencionado' e defende abraçar todos que são 'a favor do Brasil'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro described Pablo Marçal as a 'well-intentioned' person and advocated for uniting everyone 'on the side of Brazil'. During his first campaign event in São Paulo, he emphasized local partnerships and criticized the Lula administration, pledging to replicate social support programs like solidarity warehouses nationwide.

item.title: Republicanos expulsa Rodrigo Manga, o ‘prefeito tiktoker’ de Sorocaba
item.description: The Republicanos party expelled Rodrigo Manga, mayor of Sorocaba, for campaigning for his wife, Sirlange Maganhato, who is running for federal deputy under União Brasil. The decision was made by the National Ethics Council for violating party loyalty. Manga had already been suspended from the party in July.

item.title: Flávio vai “honrar” fim da reeleição se eleito, diz Tarcísio
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas stated that Flávio Bolsonaro will honor the end of reelection if elected president, emphasizing the need for leaders to make unpopular decisions. In a joint interview, Tarcísio also suggested discussing political reform, including the end of reelection and district voting.

item.title: Caso Lulinha: PGR faz 2º drible a Mendonça e atrai relator para armadilha regimental no STF
item.description: The Brazilian Public Prosecutor's Office requested the transfer of investigations involving Fábio Lulinha to a lower court, aiming to prevent Supreme Judge André Mendonça from remaining as rapporteur. The defense is expected to appeal, and the case may proceed to a panel vote with divided opinions among the justices.

item.title: Petistas descartam chance de Mendonça enviar inquéritos de Lulinha à primeira instância
item.description: Lula's allies do not believe Minister André Mendonça will accept the PGR's request to move the inquiries involving Fábio Lula da Silva to a lower court. The scenario is viewed as unlikely by the petista circle closely watching the STF decision.

item.title: Lula, Flávio e Caiado precisarão do Congresso para implementar planos na saúde
item.description: Candidates such as Lula, Flávio, and Caiado will need Congress to implement their health policies, due to requirements for budget approval, legislation, and intergovernmental negotiation. Managing the SUS requires political coordination, especially under the 2024-2027 PPA framework.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é o único candidato a presidente com conta no Discord
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is the only presidential candidate with an official Discord account, a platform suspended in Brazil following a teen's self-harm livestream. The national data protection agency banned live streams and video sharing to protect minors, while First Lady Janja also called for the platform's closure. Flávio criticized the decision, accusing Lula of censorship.

item.title: Motta vai com Lula ao RN em meio à pressão sobre taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta traveled with Lula to Rio Grande do Norte to discuss priority legislative agendas, including the 'blusinhas tax' MP. The meeting aims to strengthen dialogue between the Executive and Congress, focusing on support for Lula's reelection campaign. Motta thanked the president for publicly declaring support for his reelection.

item.title: Flávio chama Marçal de “cara do bem” e “bem intencionado”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praised Pablo Marçal as “a good person” and “well-intentioned,” reinforcing the right-wing coalition around his presidential bid. The statement emphasized the strategy of uniting conservative forces while criticizing Lula to rally support. Despite being ineligible until 2032 due to an electoral conviction, Marçal keeps his candidacy alive through the PRTB, pending TSE approval.

item.title: Prefeita petista apoia Cleitinho, rival de Patrus em Minas Gerais
item.description: PT mayor Jackeliny Nascimento publicly endorsed senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) in the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race, prompting criticism from the state PT, which backed Patrus Ananias. Despite backlash, she continued supporting Cleitinho on social media.

item.title: TSE barra distribuição de recursos e propaganda eleitoral de Pablo Marçal
item.description: The TSE unanimously decided to ban Pablo Marçal (PRTB) from public campaign funding, electoral advertising, and debates, responding to a request from the Public Ministry of Elections (MPE) challenging his party affiliation. Justice Estela Aranha highlighted evidence suggesting Marçal was affiliated with União Brasil, casting doubt on his temporary affiliation with PRTB. The decision remains in effect until the ruling on his candidacy registration, with a legal deadline of September 14.

item.title: Lula recebe R$ 150 mil do fundo partidário do PT, e Zema ganha R$ 2,5 mi do Novo
item.description: The PT transferred R$150,000 from its party fund to Lula's presidential campaign, while Novo allocated R$2.5 million from the same source to Romeu Zema's campaign. Both party leadership teams are the first to report contributions to the Electoral Court in the race for the Presidency.
